name: Phyllis Fitzgerald
original_name: フィリス・フイッツジェラルド
source: Phyllis is a succubus who moves to Keita's home because she has to pass a final exam to prove her worthiness. Her assignment includes extracting every single drop of Keita's semen, which is inexplicably potent. Fortunately for Phyllis, Keita and her classmates are more than willing to help her in her task.
